title: Watch: US Forces Board Veronica III Tanker In Indian Ocean Amid Venezuela Oil Crackdown
description: The United States military has boarded a second oil tanker accused of violating US sanctions in the Indian Ocean after a long tracking mission that began in the Caribbean Sea. The tanker, Veronica III, is connected to Venezuela and Iran, and US forces say it tried to evade a quarantine order., US News, Times Now

title: Iran’s Abbas Araghchi departs for Geneva for second round of US nuclear talks
description: Iran’s Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi departs for Geneva for a second round of indirect nuclear talks with the United States as Oman-mediated diplomacy resumes amid efforts to revive negotiations.

title: Iran wants US nuclear agreement that benefits both sides
description: Iran is aiming to reach a nuclear agreement with the United States that brings economic benefits to both countries.

title: Iran-US Indirect Talks to Be Held in Geneva on February 17
description: Indirect talks between Iran and the United States on the Iranian nuclear issue will be held in Geneva on Tuesday, February 17, the Iranian Foreign Ministry said on Sunday.

title: Can the United States repeat its Venezuela success in Iran?
description: Can the Trump administration do in Iran what it pulled off in Venezuela last month? President Trump took out Nicolás Maduro seemingly with ease; could he do the same to Iran’s supreme leader, Ali Khamenei? Trump has changed the conversation in Washington, remaking the foreign-policy game, in ways even his opponents sometimes have to admit are for the better.

title: Iran Says 'Ready To Talk' Nuclear Deal With US - But There’s A Catch
description: Iran says it is willing to discuss limits on its nuclear programme with the United States, but only if lifting economic sanctions is part of the same negotiation., World News, Times Now

title: Iran signals flexibility on nuclear deal as US demands no atomic weapon: 'If they are sincere...'
description: Majid Takht-Ravanchi, Iran’s deputy foreign minister, told the BBC that Tehran is open to compromise if the United States demonstrates genuine intent.

title: Trump, Netanyahu agreed US should press Iran to cut oil sales to China, Axios reports
description: President Donald Trump and Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu have agreed to a plan. The United States will work to cut Iran's oil exports to China. This move aims to increase pressure on Iran. China stated its normal trade cooperation is legitimate. This development comes as US and Iranian diplomats held talks on Iran's nuclear program.

title: 'The ball is in America's court': Iran signals readiness to compromise in nuclear deal if US lifts sanctions
description: US News: Iran’s deputy foreign minister Majid Takht-Ravanchi said that Tehran is ready to consider compromises to reach a nuclear deal with the United States, .

title: 'The ball is in America's court': Iran signals readiness to compromise in nuclear deal if US lifts sanctions
